Resizable orbs, a fix for Claude Buddy slowing to a crawl when many tmux sessions are open, an Account picker for New chat, and Interrupt and End for OpenClaw orbs.

## New

- **Orbs are resizable.** A new **Size** slider under Settings → Orbs sets how big every orb is, from 60% to 200% on macOS and 70% to 200% on Windows. Right-click any orb and choose **Size** to set that one orb on its own, or choose **Default** to have it follow the slider again. Each agent remembers its size across restarts. When orbs of different sizes are arranged together, the shape is spaced for the largest orb, so nothing overlaps. The settings are `orbSize` and `orbSizes` in settings.json.
- **New chat can start a Claude Code session under a second account.** When you've configured more than one Claude Code profile (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`), the New chat dialog shows an **Account** picker. It stays hidden for Codex, Grok and OpenClaw, and when only one account is configured.
- **Interrupt and End on an OpenClaw orb.** An OpenClaw orb's right-click menu now has rows to interrupt the current run and to end the conversation.

## Fixed

- **Claude Buddy no longer grinds to a halt when many tmux sessions are open.** On every scan, about every two seconds, Buddy used to run `tmux` and a full `ps` listing for each session in a tmux pane, one after another on the thread that draws the UI. With a dozen or more sessions open, menus, dragging and chat panels all became sluggish. That work now happens in the background, with one `ps` and one `tmux list-panes` per tmux server per scan. This had been in every release since 0.5.4-beta.
- **Dragging an arranged shape sideways no longer gets lost after re-arranging.** The saved position of an arrangement could drift past the edge of the screen, and after that, drags back toward the screen were absorbed. Buddy now saves where the shape actually landed, and repairs an out-of-range position the first time you arrange.
- **The New chat dialog no longer freezes stretched and unclickable on macOS** after switching between Claude Code and another CLI.
- **A team member's own profile file now decides its whole persona.** A member profile that named itself but no picture used to take its picture from the lead's persona instead, so the orb wore the lead's face.

## Known limitations

- Orb sizing and mixed-size arrangements were checked on a real Windows desktop at 100% display scaling, and orb sizing was tried by hand on a Mac. Display scaling other than 100% on Windows hasn't been tried.
- On Windows, one more slow call still runs on the UI thread when a new session appears (CB-212).
- Orbs smaller than 70% aren't offered on Windows. Windows won't make a window shorter than 39 pixels, and the strip left under a smaller orb would catch clicks.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `ClaudeBuddy-0.5.8-beta-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `ClaudeBuddy-0.5.8-beta-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `ClaudeBuddy-0.5.8-beta-win-x64-setup.exe` |

## Upgrading

Replace the app as usual. **On macOS, if you re-install you have to re-grant the Automation and Local Network permissions.** Replacing `/Applications/Claude Buddy.app` gives the app a new code identity, and macOS doesn't carry those permissions over to it. Without Automation, click-to-focus stops working; without Local Network, anything on your LAN, such as an OpenClaw gateway, can't be reached. Re-grant both in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
